resources.string: Photo Order Fix

Moved from iPhone to Android and now Instagram, KakaoTalk or other apps show your photos in the wrong order?

Those apps sort by when a file arrived on the phone, not when it was taken. A bulk transfer makes every photo arrive at once, often newest first, so the order comes out reversed or jumbled.

This app finds each photo's real date and re-saves your photos and videos oldest first, so every app shows them newest on top again. Everything happens on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.
Check my photos

How it works: each item is copied with identical content, oldest first. Then Android asks you once per batch to allow deleting the originals. If you decline, the copies are removed and nothing changes.
Good to know: \"Favorite\" marks in your gallery app may be lost. Your gallery\'s own order does not change. Some apps only show the new order after you restart them.
